heroHeadline: DeepSeek and Huawei Jointly Target Nvidia's Inference-Time Compute Advantage
heroSubtitle: September 30, 2026 — DeepSeek and Huawei are mounting a coordinated challenge to Nvidia's dominance in AI inference-time compute, combining DeepSeek's software optimization with Huawei's Ascend AI hardware. The collaboration targets a key pillar of Nvidia's market position and represents a significant escalation in China's strategy to build a domestically controlled AI compute stack independent of US-controlled hardware.
